messages:
ops-oncall: paging: canary in eu-west-1 showing sticky-session regression after deploy. 15% 5xx on internal health check, user sessions not sticking to origin. observed ~12:11 UTC. tagging oncall.
sam: on it. seeing cookies set differently by proxy (SameSite flag changed?). reproducing locally with curl.
maria: confirm there were no db schema changes in this release, right?
kevin: no migrations. release only touches proxy / session cookie handling. safe to rollback flag if needed.
sam: recommend immediate rollback of traffic split to stable (canary -> 0%). can someone flip the feature flag and drain canary nodes?
product-desk: heads-up: a handful of customers reported lost session continuity in EU. not widespread yet but CX pinged.
deploy-bot: rollback action queued: release/2026-03-17-rc traffic_split set to 0% for eu-west-1. initiating drain.
sre-bot: automated rollback started by deploy-bot. Notifying oncall.
ops-oncall: executing manual verification steps: 1) flip flag 2) confirm deploy-bot action 3) tail access logs for session set cookie 4) smoke test login flow.
kevin: running smoke tests now. curl examples: ```
curl -v -H "Host: app.eu.example" https://eu.example.com/login
# look for Set-Cookie: session=...; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=None
```
sam: logs show Set-Cookie back to previous value after the rollback command triggered. removing cookie attribute that caused mismatch.
maria: monitoring error rate and session drop metric. Stopping new canary traffic :white_check_mark:.
kevin: smoke login succeeded twice in a row from different clients. sessions persisted.
product-desk: CX update: initial customers notified, they see improvement. will escalate if anything else.
deploy-bot: rollback completed: traffic_split eu-west-1 = 0%. Canary nodes marked draining.
sre-bot: follow-up checklist: - monitor 5xx rate for 30m - check redis session hit rate - ensure no user-facing 401 spikes.
ops-oncall: assigning postmortem owner: sam. collecting logs and timeframe. including deploy tags and flag flip audit. anyone else?
sam: I'll own postmortem and timeline. quick notes: root cause likely proxy change in this release that altered SameSite behavior under certain cookie parse paths.
maria: I'll open a revert PR for the proxy change and include e2e for session affinity.
kevin: adding smoke test to deploy pipeline to catch cookie header changes.
sre-bot: incident status -> mitigated. will update when we hit 30m stable window or if regressions appear. :lock:
